title: Site Settings & Live Banner
description: Global settings for the website including the live update banner.

fields.label: Enable Live Banner
fields.name: enable_live_banner
fields.description: Toggle to show or hide the live update banner (e.g. 'yes' or 'no').

fields.label: Live Banner Text
fields.name: live_banner_text
fields.description: The text for the live update banner (e.g., 'Join us at the Zonkwa Townhall tomorrow at 10 AM!').

fields.label: Live Banner Link
fields.name: live_banner_link
fields.description: Optional URL for the banner to link to.

title: Home Page Sections
description: Content for the static sections of the home page like Hero, About, and Health Agenda.

fields.label: Hero Tagline
fields.name: hero_tagline
fields.description: The dynamic tagline for the hero section.

fields.label: Hero Headline
fields.name: hero_headline
fields.description: Main bold headline in the hero section.

fields.label: Hero Description
fields.name: hero_description
fields.description: Short description under the hero headline.

fields.label: Hero Image
fields.name: hero_image
fields.description: High-quality portrait of Hon. Magaji for the hero section.

fields.label: About Headline
fields.name: about_headline
fields.description: Headline for the 'Meet Hon. Amos Magaji' section.

fields.label: About Content
fields.name: about_content
fields.description: The narrative covering the origin story, professional background, and leadership journey. (Can use HTML)

fields.label: About Image
fields.name: about_image
fields.description: Image for the About section.

fields.label: Health Agenda Content
fields.name: health_agenda_content
fields.description: Special spotlight on his role as Chairman of the House Committee on Health. (Can use HTML)

title: Impact Scorecard & Projects
description: Legislative interventions, sponsored bills, and constituency projects.

fields.label: Title
fields.name: title
fields.description: Title of the project, bill, or motion.

fields.label: Category
fields.name: category
fields.description: Filter category for the scorecard (e.g., Health, Education, Infrastructure).

fields.label: Description
fields.name: description
fields.description: Brief description of the impact.

fields.label: Image
fields.name: image
fields.description: Visual proof or gallery image for the project.

fields.label: Status
fields.name: status
fields.description: Current status of the project or bill (e.g., Completed, Ongoing, Proposed).

fields.label: Title
fields.name: title
fields.description: Headline of the news article or press release.

fields.label: Cover Image
fields.name: cover_image
fields.description: Featured image for the article.

fields.label: Content
fields.name: content
fields.description: Full content of the press release. (Can use HTML)

title: Upcoming Events
description: Campaign trail events, rallies, and town halls.

fields.label: Event Name
fields.name: event_name
fields.description: Name of the event.

fields.label: Date
fields.name: date
fields.description: Date and time of the event (e.g., 'Oct 12, 2026 - 10:00 AM').

fields.label: Location
fields.name: location
fields.description: Venue or location.

fields.label: Description
fields.name: description
fields.description: Details about the event.

title: Campaign Trail Gallery
description: Dynamic photo and video grid showing him on the ground.

fields.label: Gallery Items
fields.name: gallery_items
fields.description: Add photos from the campaign trail.

title: Endorsements & Testimonials
description: Quotes from community leaders and constituents.

fields.label: Author Name
fields.name: author_name
fields.description: Name of the person giving the endorsement.

fields.label: Author Title
fields.name: author_title
fields.description: Title or role (e.g., 'Community Leader, Jaba').

fields.label: Quote
fields.name: quote
fields.description: The testimonial quote.

fields.label: Author Image
fields.name: author_image
fields.description: Photo of the person.
